content:
Raj: Postmortem follow-up: need to lock the preflight items for the regional failover dry-run. Short thread to capture owners.
Mei: Ill own DB snapshot cadence & restore verification. Will produce a 1-page checklist.
Derek: Ill take LB health-check tuning and NLB failover smoke tests (targeting 3s health check).
Priya: Ill do communications: ephemeral channel, on-call rotation, external status template.
Ops-Bot: Linked tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DR-2419 (auto-created actions).
Raj: Timeline: need preflight done by 2026-04-08 so we can run dry-run on 2026-04-10. Can owners confirm?
Mei: Confirmed. Deliverable: snapshot retention, PITR window sanity test, restore-to-temp cluster. Due 2026-04-08.
Derek: Confirmed. Deliverable: update LB health-checks, route test harness, rollback steps. Due 2026-04-07.
Priya: Confirmed. Will post invites, pre-game checklist and silence noisy alerts for the window. Due 2026-04-06.
Mei: Quick restore snippet Ill use for verification (will add to runbook):
```
# quick restore to temp cluster
aws rds create-db-snapshot --db-instance-identifier prod-main --db-snapshot-identifier dryrun-20260406
# then restore
aws rds restore-db-instance-from-db-snapshot --db-instance-identifier temp-restore --db-snapshot-identifier dryrun-20260406
```
Derek: Add to that: after restore run these queries to sanity-check important tables: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'; SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE status='pending';
Priya: Communications note: set channel topic to include incident commander, and pin runbook link + calendar invite.
Raj: Recurring pattern note from postmortems graphs: cross-region replication lag spikes when we run large analytics jobs. Action: throttle analytics upstream during failover window. Owner: Raj. Due 2026-04-05.
Mei: Also adding an item: ensure replica promotion script waits for replication slot confirmation (avoid split-brain). ETA 2026-04-07.
Derek: Will run two short traffic-shift tests: 5% then 50% then 100% (5 min holds). Schedule in dry-run script.
Priya: Ill coordinate with docs to auto-generate the status page snippet during the window.
Ops-Bot: Reminder set: owners update status by 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC.
Raj: Thanks. Ill compile these into the DR checklist template and attach to the tracker. If anyone needs quota or IAM changes, flag here and Ill escalate.
Mei: Noted  I need temporary S3 write access for the temp-restore bucket.
Derek: I might need higher NLB health-check throttle quota for the test.
Priya: Ill follow up with infra and ops for approvals.
Raj: OK closing thread for now; will reopen post-dry-run with results and remediation items.
